caption: The drawing depicts a semicircular bib-like object with a rounded neckline and two pointed corners at the top. The object is outlined with a faint brown line and has an inner border of scalloped, lace-like edging rendered in light gray. The main interior decoration consists of symmetrical, branching, floral-like patterns in pale blue and yellow, with fine yellow star-shaped motifs and curved blue stems radiating from the center bottom toward the upper sides. The background is light beige, matching the color of the paper. Handwritten notes in gray pencil are present below and to the side of the drawing, reading: "Vincent Busby October 10–13th / Eastern Woodland Hall Case. 2 E. Malaik" and "Bead work on cloth. 16" long". There is a faint, nearly invisible sketch of an uncolored shape below the main drawing. The image is on a piece of spiral-bound drawing paper, indicated by visible binding holes along the left edge.
title: Beadwork
